scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./frontend" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint:engines: cargo clippy --manifest-path engines/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --manifest-path engines/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && python3 scripts/format-extra.py --check
scripts.fmt:engines: python3 scripts/format-extra.py && cargo fmt --manifest-path engines/Cargo.toml --all && python3 scripts/format-extra.py && cargo fmt --manifest-path engines/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.check:engines: pnpm run lint:engines && pnpm run test:engines && pnpm run build:engines && pnpm run test:engines:wasm && python3 scripts/generate-engine-schemas.py --check && pnpm run test:engines:ui
